notes.title: Modifications to the unlocking conditions for subsequent levels of the game
notes.content:
The conditions for the level to unlock through have been slightly adjusted, as long as you hit the boss of the corresponding chapter, you can unlock the level archive of the next chapter.
I hope this modification can give you a better game experience and avoid duplicate experiences.

notes.title: "Simple Killer" is coming soon! Fragments from the development team.
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm Ruan Tiansi of Meme Games.
I'm glad that "SImple Killer" is finally coming to see you!
I am still a little excited, and I hope that this game can bring you a bloody adventure time in the cold winter.
Looking forward to everyone's play after the game is released!

Because I was the only one in the production team, there were still a lot of ideas about the game that hadn't come to fruition.
Includes brand new classes, more challenges, and a richer roguelite experience.
The game will gradually add new content in the coming time.
Larger versions will be released as free DLC.

Looking forward to meeting you all in the Minimalist Dungeon!

The fire is not extinguished!
